name: nvvdev
description: Open-source skills, agents and guardrails for coding agents, from the nvvdev community.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills: TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion, deep and maintainability reviews, EARS criteria, ADRs, plan grilling, devil's advocate, triage, worktrees, pre-deploy audit, threat modeling and architecture review.

plugins.name: dev-agents
plugins.description: A small software team as subagents: coordinator, functional analyst, tech lead, code auditor, QA, security reviewer, area engineers, UI/UX designer and SEO/GEO specialist, each with explicit tools and limits.

plugins.name: agent-guardrails
plugins.description: A tested hook that blocks destructive shell commands, skills to vet third-party skills and choose the lightest component, and governance templates.

plugins.name: growth-workflow
plugins.description: Marketing and launch skills: versioned product context, voice profile, landing copy with proof for every claim, post review, app store listings, launch checklist and a legal pages check.

plugins.name: growth-agents
plugins.description: A small marketing team as subagents: copywriter, content strategist, growth marketer and legal reviewer. None publishes, sends, spends money or changes prices.

plugins.name: test-driven-development
plugins.description: Drives work as red-green-refactor cycles at the module's public boundary, and forbids weakening tests to get green.

plugins.name: systematic-debugging
plugins.description: Reproduce first, one hypothesis at a time, fix at the source, stop after three failed attempts, redact secrets.

plugins.name: verification-before-completion
plugins.description: Fresh evidence after the last change, checked against each acceptance criterion, plus an honest list of what was weakened or skipped.

plugins.name: code-review-deep
plugins.description: Reviews only what changed for bugs, breaking changes, security and half-activated features; every finding has a verdict, severity and file:line.

plugins.name: code-review-maintainability
plugins.description: Reviews shape, not bugs: size, branching, shallow modules, leaky layers; few high-conviction comments.

plugins.name: grill-the-plan
plugins.description: Walks a spec or plan one question at a time, updating the glossary and drafting ADRs as decisions are made.

plugins.name: ears-acceptance-criteria
plugins.description: Turns vague requirements into EARS acceptance criteria and gives every task a verification command.

plugins.name: writing-adrs
plugins.description: Short ADRs in docs/adr/ with context, options, decision and honest consequences.

plugins.name: devils-advocate
plugins.description: Attacks an idea from eight angles after six forcing questions, then gives a verdict, a scope mode and a prioritized fix list.

plugins.name: issue-triage
plugins.description: Assigns each item one of five states and writes self-contained briefs for agent-ready work.

plugins.name: git-worktrees
plugins.description: One worktree per task on its own branch, with safe cleanup that never discards work.

plugins.name: finishing-a-branch
plugins.description: Final checks, self-review of the diff, Conventional Commits and a PR description; never merges or pushes to main.

plugins.name: pre-deploy-audit
plugins.description: Release blockers (secrets, debug settings, missing config, unsafe migrations) and a deploy plan with health check and rollback.

plugins.name: threat-modeling
plugins.description: Assets, entry points and trust boundaries, then concrete threats across twelve domains with mitigations and tests.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Hotspots from churn × complexity, five ranked refactoring candidates, no changes made.

plugins.name: anti-generic-design-review
plugins.description: Finds the traits that make an interface look generated by default and replaces each with a deliberate, brand-specific decision.

plugins.name: vetting-external-skills
plugins.description: Read without running, SkillSpector scan, fit and cost check, pin to a commit, record in a lockfile, credit the source.

plugins.name: choosing-agent-components
plugins.description: A decision order from 'nothing' to 'plugin' that picks the cheapest component that reliably does the job.

plugins.name: product-context
plugins.description: Creates and maintains a versioned .agents/product-context.md (product, ideal customer, positioning, objections, proof, learnings) that copy, content, design and SEO work read first.

plugins.name: voice-profile
plugins.description: Builds about-me.md and voice.md from a short interview and three to five real texts; asks before starting.

plugins.name: landing-copy
plugins.description: Writes page copy from the keyword map and product context - headline, subheadline, benefits, objections, CTA, with variants - where every claim has proof.

plugins.name: post-review
plugins.description: Scores a draft post on hook, single idea, proof, voice, network format and CTA, and returns corrections. Never publishes.

plugins.name: app-store-listing
plugins.description: Writes Play Store and App Store listings (title, descriptions, screenshot script, keywords per language) consistent with the data safety section and privacy labels.

plugins.name: launch-checklist
plugins.description: Before and after a launch: measurement, legal pages, store listing, announcement, feedback channel and rollback plan, with evidence for every item.

plugins.name: legal-pages-check
plugins.description: Checks privacy policy, terms and cookie notice against a per-country checklist (Colombia's Law 1581 as example) and what the app declares; flags what a lawyer must see. Not legal advice.
